your destination, the 344-acre Brackenridge Park.

and residential neighborhoods, encountering a
number of popular restaurants and eateries should you
want to stop for a bite.
• Brackenridge Park is on a site that once held a rock
quarry, a Civil War-era tannery, and a waterworks.
